ways.label: Mount Bealey Track to the bushline

start.name: end of Mount Bealey Road
start.quote: the end of Mount Bealey Road

end.name: bushline
end.quote: The track ends at the bushline

ways.distance: 3.2 km (610 m vertical climb) to the bushline return via same track
evidence: Mount Bealey Track starts at the end of Mount Bealey Road in Arthur’s Pass village.
The track ends at the bushline.

doubts: The end is the bushline, which has no feature or name in the packet, so its ref is null. The Mount Bealey summit is beyond the end of the track (no track or marked route), so it is not recorded as part of the way. The 'Arthur’s Pass' view is ambiguous between the place and the pass, so no ref.
